parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: The switch is the handle of the faucet, typically made of brass for durability and corrosion resistance.
parts.Functional_description: It controls the flow of water by rotating to open or close the internal valve mechanism.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around its central axis to regulate water flow.

parts.name: Frame
parts.Basic_description: The frame is the central body of the faucet, made of brass, connecting the switch and spout.
parts.Functional_description: It houses the valve mechanism and connects the water inlet to the spout.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and serves as the structural support for the faucet assembly.

parts.name: Spout
parts.Basic_description: The spout is the curved outlet of the faucet, made of brass, through which water flows out.
parts.Functional_description: It directs the water flow from the valve to the sink or basin.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed in place and does not move during operation.
